summary: Completed testing of AI Route Optimization feature. Fixed critical backend bug where route-score and optimize-route endpoints were being matched as {intervention_id} due to FastAPI route ordering. All 16 backend tests pass. Frontend UI working correctly - route optimizer button visible, modal opens, AI optimization succeeds, and apply button available.

fixed.issue: Route was returning 404 'Intervention non trouvée' because FastAPI matched 'route-score' as an intervention_id
fixed.fix: Moved route optimization endpoints BEFORE /interventions/{intervention_id} route

fixed.issue: intervention_ids parameter was not being parsed correctly from comma-separated query string
fixed.fix: Changed parameter type from List[str] to str and added manual parsing

minor_issues.issue: React warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'
minor_issues.impact: Accessibility warning only, no functional impact

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: FastAPI route ordering issue - specific routes like /route-score must be defined BEFORE parameterized routes like /{intervention_id}
FIXED: Query parameter parsing - intervention_ids now correctly parsed from comma-separated string
route_optimizer.py: Well-structured AI integration with proper fallback handling when AI fails
TechnicianApp.jsx: RouteOptimizerModal correctly shows loading state, results, and apply button
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Moved route optimization endpoints before {intervention_id} routes, fixed intervention_ids parsing
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing interventions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Route Optimization feature fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) POST /api/interventions/optimize-route - AI optimization using GPT-4o via Emergent LLM key, returns optimized order with tips and estimated time, 2) GET /api/interventions/route-score - Simple route efficiency score without AI (0-100), 3) POST /api/interventions/apply-optimized-order - Admin only, updates ordre_tournee field on interventions, 4) Frontend RouteOptimizerModal shows when 2+ planned interventions, displays loading state, results with numbered order, and apply button. AI may fail due to budget limits but fallback to original order works correctly.

test_1_optimize_route_endpoint.evidence: Returns optimized_order, route_summary, tips, estimated_time, ai_optimized flag

test_2_route_score_endpoint.evidence: Returns score (0-100), issues, suggestions, city_changes, urgent_interventions

test_3_apply_optimized_order.evidence: Updates ordre_tournee field on interventions, returns 403 for non-admin

test_4_route_optimizer_button.description: Route optimizer button visible when 2+ planned interventions
test_4_route_optimizer_button.evidence: Sparkle icon button visible in header when conditions met

test_5_route_optimizer_modal.description: RouteOptimizerModal opens and shows optimize button
test_5_route_optimizer_modal.evidence: Modal opens with title 'Optimisation de tournée IA' and 'Optimiser ma tournée' button

test_6_ai_optimization_result.description: AI optimization returns results with suggested order
test_6_ai_optimization_result.evidence: Shows 'Itinéraire optimisé' with numbered interventions, route summary, and tips

test_7_apply_button.evidence: 'Appliquer cet ordre' button visible after successful optimization

test_8_fallback_behavior.description: Fallback to original order on AI error
test_8_fallback_behavior.evidence: Backend returns ai_optimized=false with original order when AI fails

mocked_apis.note: AI optimization uses real GPT-4o via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. May fail due to budget limits - fallback is expected behavior.

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: FastAPI route ordering - /interventions/route-score was being matched as /interventions/{intervention_id}
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Moved route optimization endpoints (optimize-route, route-score, apply-optimized-order) BEFORE the {intervention_id} parameterized routes

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: intervention_ids query parameter not parsed correctly from comma-separated string
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Changed parameter type from List[str] to str and added manual parsing with split(',')
